fields.description: Extra issue focused on a run on Miami banks, with editorial commentary urging calm and asserting local banks’ stability, including discussion of the Southern Bank & Trust Company and the Lummus family. Includes local political and civic commentary (including a column item on Jim Carson), humorous verse and satirical pieces, brief interview-style reactions to the banking situation, and extensive bank advertising and published condensed statements of condition for multiple South Florida banks dated February 4, 1928. Also notes local deaths and incidents and short items about tourism and entertainment in Miami and Miami Beach.
